events.title: Certiorari Denied in Black v. Tennessee
events.summary: The Supreme Court denied both the application for a stay of execution and the petition for a writ of certiorari in the case of Byron L. Black v. Tennessee. The application was initially presented to Justice Kavanaugh, who referred it to the full Court. The denial means that the execution of Byron L. Black's death sentence will proceed as scheduled, and the Court will not review the case.
events.why_relevant: The denial of certiorari and stay of execution affects the administration of justice and the finality of capital punishment cases.
